title: Talk it through 1.2
role: Guest relations officer talking with a guest who is not happy
can_do: I can say how I feel and what makes me feel that way.
I can agree and disagree politely.

nodes.partner_line: I'm a bit annoyed. The pool is closed and nobody told us.
nodes.translation: Estoy un poco molesto. La piscina está cerrada y nadie nos avisó.

options.text: I understand, and I'm sorry. We should have told you.
I see why you are annoyed. Let me check why it is closed.
You are right. That is really frustrating.

nodes.partner_line: The weather is awful and the day is very boring. What can we do?
nodes.translation: El clima es horrible y el día es muy aburrido. ¿Qué podemos hacer?
nodes.model_reply: You could visit the museum, which is very interesting.

nodes.partner_line: I think the new menu is too expensive.
nodes.translation: Creo que el nuevo menú es demasiado caro.

options.text: I see your point; however, the portions are quite big.
You may be right. I'll pass your comment on.
I'm afraid I disagree, but thank you for telling me.

nodes.partner_line: The tour was really exciting, don't you think?
nodes.translation: El tour fue muy emocionante, ¿no cree?

options.text: Yes, exactly. The guide was great.
I agree. I was very excited at the end.
To be honest, I was a little bored in the first part.

nodes.partner_line: I'm disappointed with our room. It is small and noisy.
nodes.translation: Estoy decepcionado con nuestra habitación. Es pequeña y ruidosa.

options.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I can show you another room.
I understand how you feel. Let me see what is free.
That sounds annoying. We will move you now.

nodes.partner_line: Thank you. I feel much better now.
nodes.translation: Gracias. Me siento mucho mejor ahora.

options.text: I'm glad to hear it. Enjoy your stay.
You're welcome. Please tell me if you need anything.
